name: Multi-resolution Hash Encoding
definition: Optimizes the compressed representation of MERF's grids by parameterizing them as MLPs with multi-resolution hash encoding to reduce memory usage during training, which requires storing intermediate activations and optimizer statistics.
summary: Multi-resolution Hash Encoding accelerates NeRF training by replacing deep MLPs with a trainable hash grid that maps 3D coordinates to feature vectors via lookups and interpolation, significantly reducing learning time.
